name: Ioua

attributes.attribute: an ancient Scottish moon goddess whose name the sacred island of Iona bears

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ioua is a Scottish goddess. She is an ancient moon goddess. She gave her name to the sacred island of Iona.
objective: Document the Scottish moon goddess Ioua.
key_results: Record Ioua as an ancient moon goddess.
Note that she gave her name to the island of Iona.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Ioua entry.
